# clear_food_clamshell

Round 2: **TARGET NOT MET**. 1 dishware instances. Authoritative comparison: [photo, render and overlay](../review/clear_food_clamshell_compare.jpg); [numerical report](../qa_report.json). Earlier reconstruction prose is retained in [Round 1 history](../review/round2_before/clear_food_clamshell/notes.md).

## Evidence and shape

Same supplied metric OpenCV cameras, WORLD metres with +Z up; GLB uses +Y up. Metric scale is inherited from reconstruction, not a tape measure. Each instance keeps its measured pose, orientation, scale and provenance in `model.json`. Source photographs are motion blurred and some boundaries are occluded; typical manual boundary uncertainty is 8 source pixels.

| Frame | IoU | Photo visible W/H, px | Model visible W/H, px | RGB histogram distance |
|---|---:|---|---|---:|
| f1608 | 0.9030 | [159.0, 99.0] | [148.0, 95.0] | 0.2869 |
| f1611 | 0.9079 | [163.0, 103.0] | [151.0, 99.0] | 0.2751 |
| f1629 | 0.9085 | [201.0, 142.0] | [206.0, 134.0] | 0.2685 |

Visible extents are occlusion-limited measurements, not full product dimensions. Tiny disconnected mask fragments are excluded only from extent measurements; raw extents and all-pixel IoU remain in the report. Canonical visual bounds are `[[-0.06921499967575073, -0.059950001537799835, 0.0], [0.06921499967575073, 0.059950001537799835, 0.05690000206232071]]` metres. Shell/floor assumptions are `0.00035` / `0.00035` metres.

## Changes

- Rounded rectangular shell contact bands follow wall taper; separate lid geometry and seal
- Reused separate source-derived contents from the adjacent counter_items set for the observed filled state; kept them outside the empty-vessel mass and geometry
- Reduced PET sheet wall/lid to 0.35/0.45 mm, removed frosted diffuse contribution, and modeled two pressed clear lid beads from the source contours
- Widened the separate pressed-lid flange to match the source overhang; retained the smaller tapered body and thin PET walls
- Remeasured observed depth surfaces in three calibrated frames
- Re-fitted metric placement, scale, tilt and nesting spacing against fixed cameras
- Computed mass, COM and per-instance inertia from closed shell volumes and material densities

## Material, contact and physics

Empty canonical asset mass: **0.0285 kg**, from closed physical shell volumes and per-part densities. No manufacturer product identification or scale measurement is available. The stored ±30% range is a nominal engineering prior, not a confidence interval. Scale and unobserved wall-thickness uncertainty may be larger. Material: PET sheet; friction 0.3; restitution 0.05; fragile `False`. Per-instance masses, mass-weighted COM and inertia use each variant, scale and retained part state.

| Physical part | Density kg/m³ | Mass kg | Canonical COM m |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| body | 1380 | 0.01852 | [-0.0, 0.0, 0.01896] |
| lid | 1380 | 0.00996 | [-0.0, 0.0, 0.05578] |

50 convex contacts follow the floor, segmented thin walls, handles/stems and separate closure parts. They preserve vessel cavities; they are not a liquid boundary. Convexity, watertightness and open-axis checks passed. The individual upright 2-second Blender settling check passed. These checks do not certify assembled stacking, rack hanging, robot grasping, fracture, or friction accuracy.

Deformable model (tentative, with rigid fallback): `{"model": "thin shell linear elastic, tentative", "youngs_modulus_pa": 2000000000.0, "poisson_ratio": 0.38, "damping_ratio": 0.08, "thickness_m": 0.00035, "lid_thickness_m": 0.00045, "fallback": "compound rigid shell", "implemented_in_blender": false}`. This is a material specification; a soft-body solver is not implemented in the Blender file.

Joints: `[]`. Detachable parts: `["lid"]`. Rigid vessel; detachable lids/strainers, when listed, remain independent bodies.

Optional photographed contents are separate bodies in [context/model.json](context/model.json) and [context/model.glb](context/model.glb). Their contacts and tentative physical properties are separate from the empty vessel. They were snapshotted from the adjacent `counter_items` asset and must be instantiated only once across sets. The food fill is an aggregate appearance/occupancy proxy; its modeled pieces do not establish the real food count.

## Appearance and reproducibility

Glass uses physical transmission, IOR 1.5 and thin inner/outer walls. Glaze and metal parameters are stored in `material_parameters`; they are material priors, not measured BRDFs. Photo rebakes and inferred generated details are documented in [texture provenance](../review/round2_texture_provenance.json). No source object image is inserted into a glass shader or review background. Bounded exposure/white-balance fitting is in-sample, using the same review frames. The offline renderer records actual wall times, sample count, resolution and denoising under `review/`.

Build this asset with `QA_FAST=1 blender -b -P build.py`. Run the set-level `round2_render.py -- clear_food_clamshell`, `round2_physics.py`, and `round2_report.py` for calibrated reviews and metadata. `model.glb` is visual geometry; simulation importers must also read the JSON joints and compound collision files.

## Remaining

- Separate closure parts/contact and clip hinge directions match observed open/closed states; hinge ranges are inferred and snap force is unmeasured
- Appearance target A not reached: masked RGB histogram distance 0.277; environment, view-dependent reflections and unresolved surface detail remain
- Mass is a density/closed-shell estimate with nominal uncertainty (usually ±30%; ambiguous lower-shelf metal cup variants ±65%); product identity and wall thickness unmeasured
- No full assembled stack/rack dynamics, breakage or robot-grasp validation

physics_properties.mass_basis: Closed visual-shell volume times documented material density; excludes open decals; not a manufacturer weight
physics_properties.centre_of_mass_basis: Mass-weighted closed-shell integrals, using separate part densities (including bamboo lids); open decals excluded.
physics_properties.product_identification: Not established; density-based estimate, not weighed or manufacturer verified
physics_properties.friction_basis: User-specified material-pair prior; no slip-angle experiment in capture
physics_properties.contact_model: Rigid compound convex shell bands; thin margins; fragile objects do not fracture. Deformable flags retain explicit rigid fallback.

provenance.geometry: Reconstructed from kitchen video; hidden surfaces are completed. Scale and material appearance remain approximate.
provenance.motion: Observed trajectories where documented; unobserved axes and endpoints are assumptions.
provenance.forces: Simulation measurements of assumed parameters; not force measurements from video.

visual_bindings_note: Visuals use the latest asset revision; mechanism geometry may predate it. Body rest offsets preserve the visual placement.
